package_populations.note: The handoff 02 prose said 116 measured packages; the array holds 129 (source, path) rows (13 sources × up to 12 family/index slots; NHL 07 lacks leaguelogosbig and index 5, NHL 08 lacks leaguelogosbig). No subset rule reproduces 116; 129 rows / 102 distinct byte contents are the measured populations.

skipped: Vectors only cover the UNCHANGED stock plaintext re-encoded by Studio's pre-D4 encoders; an edited texture or text compresses to an unrelated length, so no fit verdict here bounds an actual edit — placement must be decided from the actual encoded replacement at plan time.
Inner vectors: only leaguelogos/leaguelogossmall/leaguelogosbig index 0 on six chains; leaguelogoswide and indices 1/5 were not re-encoded.

BIG4 slot slack is measured to the next directory entry's offset; entries are 64-byte aligned so the gap is the alignment remainder. Gap bytes were read and checked for zero on every vector slot here; no other gap in these archives is asserted zero (the survey checked 389–2 300 gaps per archive, not all).
EB slots on 0x00110400 archives: the vector members are not shared spans (checked by unique offset), but shared-span members elsewhere must not be rewritten in place regardless of fit.

The chunkzip vectors' studio_encoder_len is the pre-D4 miniz_oxide single-chunk output; not re-run against the D4 native encoder (developer-owned; its receipt reports byte identity on its own fixtures).

Whole-file SHA-256 of the multi-gigabyte source archives was not computed; each vector is identified by archive path + entry index + offset + stored size + stored/plain SHA-256, re-verified at read time.
